The '''Kuna&#39;s Tooth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuna's Tooth/Legends|Kuna's Tooth]].
